knockback_adj:
The multiplier to knockback dealt to you:
1 = default value
higher values = lighter character
lower values = heavier character
[0.9 - 1.2]
walk_speed:
The maximum speed you can achieve while walking, in pixels per frame

[3 - 4.5]
walk_accel:
The speed gained per frame while walking

[0.2 -0.5]
walk_turn_time:
The number of frames it takes to turn around

[6 for all characters]
initial_dash_time:
The number of frames in your initial dash

[8 - 16]
initial_dash_speed:
The speed of your initial dash in pixels per frame

[4 - 11]
dash_speed:
The speed of your run in pixels per frame

[4.75 - 9]
dash_turn_time:
The number of frames it takes to turn while running

[8 - 20]
dash_turn_accel:
The acceleration applied when turning while running

[0.1 - 2]
dash_stop_time:
The number of frames it takes to stop while running

[4 - 6]
dash_stop_percent:
The value to multiply your horizontal speed by when going into idle from dash or dashstop

[0.25 -0.5]
ground_friction:
Natural deceleration while on the ground

[0.3 - 1]
moonwalk_accel:
The acceleration to apply while moonwalking

[1.2 - 1.4]
max_djumps:
The number of double jumps you can perform before touching the ground again

[0 - 3]
jump_start_time:
The number of frames of jumpsquat minus one

[5 for all characters]
jump_speed:
The vertical speed applied when fullhopping

[7.6 - 12]
short_hop_speed:
The vertical speed applied when shorthopping

[4 - 7.4]
djump_speed:
The vertical speed applied when double jumping

[8 - 12, -1 for Absa]
jump_change:
The horizontal speed applied if left or right is held when jumping. Will not slow you down if you're already going faster. When reversing your momentum with a double jump, this is the maximum horizontal speed you can have

[3 for all characters]
djump_accel:
The amount of acceleration to apply during your double jump. Allows for Absa-style double jump cancels

[-1.4]
djump_accel_start_time:
The first frame of your double jump that acceleration is applied

[4]
djump_accel_end_time:
The last frame of your double jump that acceleration is applied

[15]
leave_ground_max:
The maximum horizontal speed you can have when you go from grounded to aerial without jumping

[4 - 8]
air_max_speed:
The maximum horizontal speed you can accelerate to when in a normal aerial state

[3 - 7]
max_jump_horizontal speed:
The maximum horizontal speed you can have when jumping from the ground

[4 - 8]
air_accel:
The horizontal speed acceleration applied when you hold left or right in a normal aerial state

[0.2 -0.4]
air_friction:
Natural deceleration applied while in the air. Also applies while in hitstun

[0.02 -0.07]
double_jump_time:
The number of frames to play the double jump animation. Most characters have a value of 32 so that the double jump animation transitions into the falling portion of the normal jump animation

[24 - 40]
gravity_speed:
The gravitational acceleration applied in non-non-hitstun aerial states

[0.3 -0.6]
hitstun_grav:
The gravitational acceleration applied in hitstun

[0.45 -0.525]
max_fall:
The maximum vertical speed you can accelerate to while falling normally

[8 - 11]
fast_fall:
The vertical speed applied when fastfalling

[11 - 16]
land_time:
The number of frames in your normal landing state

[4 - 6]
prat_land_time:
The number of frames in your prat land state

[3 - 24]
prat_fall_accel:
A multiplier to your normal horizontal aerial acceleration: 1 = normal 0 = no acceleration

[0.4 - 1.5]
walljump_horizontal speed:
The horizontal speed to apply while walljumping, in pixels per frame

[4 - 7]
walljump_vertical speed:
The vertical speed to apply while walljumping, in pixels per frame

[7 - 10]
walljump_time:
The number of frames the walljump state takes. Normally 32, but some characters have shorter values

[18 - 32]
roll_forward_max:
The speed of your forward roll

[9 - 11]
roll_backward_max:
The speed of your backward roll

[9 - 11]
wave_land_time:
The number of frames your waveland state lasts

[6 - 12, usually 8]
wave_land_adj:
The multiplier to your initial horizontal speed when wavelanding. Usually greater than 1

[1.2 - 1.5]
char_height:
Used for centering things on the character, placing the overhead HUD, etc

[36 - 74]
bubble_x:
Used for visually positioning the character in Ranno's bubble horizontally

[-8]
bubble_y:
Used for visually positioning the character in Ranno's bubble vertically

[0 - 10]
wall_frames: The number of animation frames to play before you leave the wall
dodge_startup_frames: Number of animation frames during parry's startup. Usually just 1
dodge_active_frames: Number of animation frames during parry's active frames
dodge_recovery_frames: Number of animation frames during parry's recovery frames
tech_active_frames: The number of animation frames during tech in place's invincibility
tech_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during tech in place's recovery
techroll_startup_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's startup
techroll_active_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's movement
crouch_active_frames: The number of animation frames during crouch movement
techroll_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's recovery
air_dodge_startup_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's startup (airdodge)
air_dodge_active_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's movement (airdodge)
air_dodge_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during techroll's recovery (airdodge)
roll_forward_startup_frames: The number of animation frames during roll forward's startup
crouch_startup_frames: The number of animation frames during crouch's startup
roll_forward_active_frames: The number of animation frames during roll forward's movement
roll_forward_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during roll forward's recovery
crouch_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during crouch recovery
roll_back_startup_frames: The number of animation frames during roll backward's startup
roll_back_active_frames: The number of animation frames during roll backward's movement
roll_back_recovery_frames: The number of animation frames during roll backward's recovery
idle_anim_speed: The speed of your idle animation in anim frames per gameplay frame
walk_anim_speed: The speed of your walk animation in anim frames per gameplay frame
dash_anim_speed: The speed of your dash animation in anim frames per gameplay frame
walljump_vsp: The vertical speed gained when wall jumping
walljump_hsp: The horizontal speed gained when wall jumping
crouch_anim_speed: The speed of your (held) crouch animation in anim frames per gameplay frame
pratfall_anim_speed: The speed of your pratfall animation in anim frames per gameplay frame
max_jump_hsp: The maximum horizontal speed you can gain when jumping
